title: fix(google-genai): report a streamed response as one output message per candidate

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+Report a streamed `generate_content_stream` response as one output message per candidate instead of one per chunk.

@@ -586,6 +588,41 @@ def _execute(
     return instrumented_generate_content
 
 
+def _merge_streamed_candidates(candidates: list[Candidate]) -> list[Candidate]:
+    """Merge the per-chunk candidates of a stream into one candidate per index.
+
+    Each streamed chunk carries a fragment of the response; adjacent text
+    fragments of the same kind are joined so a streamed response is reported
+    like the equivalent non-streamed one.
+    """
+    merged: dict[int, Candidate] = {}
+    for candidate in candidates:
+        index = candidate.index or 0
+        target = merged.get(index)
+        if target is None:
+            target = merged[index] = Candidate(index=candidate.index)
+        if candidate.finish_reason is not None:
+            target.finish_reason = candidate.finish_reason
+        if not candidate.content:
+            continue
+        if target.content is None:
+            target.content = Content(parts=[])
+        if candidate.content.role:
+            target.content.role = candidate.content.role
+        for part in candidate.content.parts or []:
+            last = target.content.parts[-1] if target.content.parts else None
+            if (
+                last is not None
+                and part.text is not None
+                and last.text is not None
+                and bool(part.thought) == bool(last.thought)
+            ):
+                last.text += part.text
+            else:
+                target.content.parts.append(part.model_copy())
+    return [merged[index] for index in sorted(merged)]
+

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+# Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+from google.genai.types import (
+    Candidate,
+    Content,
+    FinishReason,
+    FunctionCall,
+    Part,
+)
+
+from opentelemetry.instrumentation.google_genai.generate_content import (
+    _merge_streamed_candidates,
+)
+from opentelemetry.instrumentation.google_genai.message import (
+    to_output_messages,
+)
+
+
+def _candidate(*parts, index=None, finish_reason=None):
+    return Candidate(
+        index=index,
+        content=Content(role="model", parts=list(parts)),
+        finish_reason=finish_reason,
+    )
+
+
+def test_merges_fragments_per_candidate_index():
+    call = Part(
+        function_call=FunctionCall(name="get_weather", args={"city": "Paris"})
+    )
+    merged = _merge_streamed_candidates(
+        [
+            _candidate(Part(text="Let me ", thought=True)),
+            _candidate(Part(text="think.", thought=True)),
+            _candidate(Part(text="It is ")),
+            _candidate(Part(text="sunny."), index=1),
+            _candidate(Part(text="warm.")),
+            _candidate(call, finish_reason=FinishReason.STOP),
+            _candidate(index=1, finish_reason=FinishReason.MAX_TOKENS),
+        ]
+    )
+
+    assert merged == [
+        Candidate(
+            content=Content(
+                role="model",
+                parts=[
+                    Part(text="Let me think.", thought=True),
+                    Part(text="It is warm."),
+                    call,
+                ],
+            ),
+            finish_reason=FinishReason.STOP,
+        ),
+        Candidate(
+            index=1,
+            content=Content(role="model", parts=[Part(text="sunny.")]),
+            finish_reason=FinishReason.MAX_TOKENS,
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_does_not_mutate_the_streamed_chunks():
+    first = _candidate(Part(text="Hello"))
+    _merge_streamed_candidates([first, _candidate(Part(text=", world"))])
+
+    assert first.content.parts == [Part(text="Hello")]
+
+
+def test_contentless_candidate_produces_no_output_message():
+    merged = _merge_streamed_candidates(
+        [
+            Candidate(index=0),
+            Candidate(index=0, finish_reason=FinishReason.SAFETY),
+        ]
+    )
+
+    assert merged == [Candidate(index=0, finish_reason=FinishReason.SAFETY)]
+    assert to_output_messages(candidates=merged) == []
+
+
+def test_orders_candidates_by_index():
+    merged = _merge_streamed_candidates(
+        [
+            _candidate(Part(text="second"), index=1),
+            _candidate(Part(text="first"), index=0),
+        ]
+    )
+
+    assert [candidate.index for candidate in merged] == [0, 1]
